judgments.en_span: The Company confirms its full-year 2026 guidance of revenue between EUR 295 million and EUR 305 million and an EBITDA margin above 26%.
judgments.zh_span: La Société confirme ses objectifs pour l'exercice 2026, soit un chiffre d'affaires compris entre 295 millions et 305 millions d'euros et une marge d'EBITDA supérieure à 26 %.
judgments.explanation: Both passages confirm identical 2026 guidance with same revenue range and EBITDA margin threshold.

judgments.en_span: the Group may consider additional investments in offshore storage capacity in 2027.
judgments.zh_span: le Groupe va envisager des investissements supplémentaires dans des capacités de stockage en mer en 2027.
judgments.explanation: EN uses 'may consider' (conditional/discretionary); ZH uses 'va envisager' (will consider/intends), expressing greater commitment.

judgments.en_span: The Board of Directors will propose a dividend of EUR 0.42 per share to the annual general meeting.
judgments.zh_span: Le conseil d'administration proposera un dividende de 0,42 euro par action à l'assemblée générale annuelle.
judgments.explanation: Both passages state the Board will propose the same dividend amount to the AGM with identical meaning.
